## What this changes

## Checklist

- [ ] Facts added to a chart have sources (in the chart's notes or its research file).
- [ ] New pictures have a media record with source, author and licence; ones that may not be published are marked `private`.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes, and the tests for what I changed pass (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] No card moves in an existing chart (`npm run build:chart -- charts/<id>/chart.json --lock`), or the moves are meant, and shown here with before-and-after pictures.
